description: Component composition — agent chooses composition over configuration when building a new component
scenario: Build a task management widget that shows a list of tasks. Each task has a checkbox, title, and delete button. User wants flexibility but not over-engineering.
expected_outcome: Agent creates composable TaskItem and TaskList components with clear separation of concerns and avoids a monolithic configuration-heavy component

description: Accessible form — agent builds a signup form meeting WCAG 2.1 AA standards
scenario: Build a signup form with name, email, and password fields. Must be keyboard-navigable, have proper labels, error states, and focus management.
expected_outcome: Agent creates a form with proper label-element associations, ARIA descriptions, keyboard navigation (Tab order preserved), inline validation errors with aria-live, and focus management on error

description: Responsive design — agent adapts a desktop layout to mobile-first
scenario: Convert a fixed-width 3-column dashboard layout to be responsive. Must work on 320px, 768px, 1024px, and 1440px widths. Use semantic color tokens from the design system.
expected_outcome: Agent implements a mobile-first grid that stacks on small screens, expands on larger ones. Uses consistent spacing scale. Never uses raw hex colors — always semantic tokens.

description: Empty state handling — agent adds proper empty/error/loading states
scenario: A notification panel component currently shows nothing when the user has no notifications. Agent must add meaningful empty, loading, and error states.
expected_outcome: Agent adds: skeleton loading animation, empty state with helpful message and CTA, error state with retry button. All states are keyboard accessible.

description: Anti-AI-aesthetic — agent avoids generic AI design patterns and uses project design tokens
scenario: The project uses a warm earthy color palette with subtle shadows and rounded-sm corners. Agent builds a settings panel page. Must use project tokens, no purple gradients, no stock card grids.
expected_outcome: Agent uses the project's semantic color tokens, applies consistent border-radius from the design system, uses purpose-driven layout (not stock grid), no purple/indigo, no excessive gradients
